description: This file defines classes and protocols for planning and managing the save and load processes of distributed checkpointing in PyTorch, including abstract base classes for save/load planners, data structures for plan items, and metadata handling.

classes.name: WriteItemType
classes.description: Enumeration for types of items to write (TENSOR, SHARD, BYTE_IO).

classes.name: LoadItemType
classes.description: Enumeration for types of items to load (TENSOR, BYTE_IO).

classes.name: BytesIOWriteData
classes.description: Data class holding the number of bytes to write for BytesIO data.

classes.name: TensorWriteData
classes.description: Data class holding metadata for tensor write operations, including chunk metadata, properties, and size.

classes.name: WriteItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item to be written, including index, type, and associated data.

classes.name: ReadItem
classes.description: Data class representing an item to be read, including indices, offsets, and lengths.

classes.name: SavePlan
classes.description: Data class representing a plan for saving, including items, storage data, and metadata.

classes.name: LoadPlan
classes.description: Data class representing a plan for loading, including items, storage data, and metadata.

classes.name: SavePlanner
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the protocol for planning distributed save operations.

classes.name: LoadPlanner
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the protocol for planning distributed load operations.

methods.name: tensor_storage_size
methods.description: Calculates the storage size in bytes of the tensor data, or None if not applicable.

methods.name: set_up_planner
methods.description: Initialize the planner with the given state_dict and metadata, called on all ranks.

methods.name: create_local_plan
methods.description: Create a local save/load plan based on current state, called on all ranks.

methods.name: create_global_plan
methods.description: Create a global plan from all local plans, called on the coordinator rank.

methods.name: finish_plan
methods.description: Finalize and merge local and global plans, called on all ranks.

methods.name: resolve_data
methods.description: Transform and prepare a write item for storage, called multiple times on each rank.

methods.name: load_bytes
methods.description: Load data into the state_dict from a BytesIO object, called multiple times during load.

methods.name: resolve_bytes
methods.description: Return a BytesIO object for loading data, not implemented in base class.

methods.name: resolve_tensor
methods.description: Return a tensor for loading data, to be used by the storage reader.

methods.name: commit_tensor
methods.description: Post-process a tensor after loading, to be copied back into the state_dict.
